projectEstimator.title: What will your project cost?
projectEstimator.lead: Configure your website or web product and get a non-binding price indication in under a minute. Direct collaboration, a sharp project price, no agency markup layer.

decrypt.lockedHint: Complete earlier steps to unlock this channel

one-page.label: One-page website
one-page.body: A compact site where all key information lives on a single page.

business.label: Business website
business.body: A professional multi-page website. The base includes 3 pages.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.body: For creatives, freelancers or small brands that need to show their work.

webshop.label: Webshop
webshop.body: A site where products can be sold and paid for.
webshop.note: External costs for payment providers, subscriptions or transaction fees are not included by default.

webapp.label: Web application
webapp.body: Custom work: dashboards, accounts, tools or other interactive systems.
webapp.note: This is a first indication only. Custom scope varies strongly per project.

pages.title: How many pages do you need?
pages.included: {count} pages included in the base price
pages.overMax: More than {max} pages? Get in touch for a custom scope.

design.title: How far should the design go?

clean.label: Clean
clean.body: Professional and polished, with subtle interactions.

custom.label: Custom
custom.body: More custom layout, visuals and animation work.

showcase.label: Showcase
showcase.body: Design and interactive presentation as a core part of the build: scroll effects, custom transitions, showcase elements.

features.title: Which modules do you want to add?
features.multiHint: Select every module you need. Multiple selections allowed.

contact-form.label: Contact form
contact-form.body: A clear form for inquiries and messages.

cms.label: CMS
cms.body: Manage selected copy or page sections yourself.

blog.label: Blog / news
blog.body: A news or blog section for updates.

multilingual.label: Multilingual
multilingual.body: Technical support for multiple languages. Translation work itself is not included.

maps.label: Google Maps / location
maps.body: A map or location block on the site.

newsletter.label: Newsletter signup
newsletter.body: Signup block connected to your newsletter tool.

social.label: Social media integration
social.body: Profiles and share actions cleanly connected.

advanced-animations.label: Advanced animations
advanced-animations.body: Richer motion for presentation and brand feel.

api.label: API integration
api.body: Connection to an external service. Complexity varies by case.

dashboard.label: Personal dashboard
dashboard.body: A dedicated space for users or admins.

ai.label: AI functionality
ai.body: Integration with existing AI services. External API costs not included.

payments.label: Online payments
payments.body: Checkout/payment flow. Provider, subscription and transaction fees not included.

booking.label: Booking or reservation system
booking.body: Appointments or reservations. External subscription costs not included.

self.label: I will supply texts and images
self.body: You provide the content, I build the site.

polish.label: Help improve my existing copy
polish.body: Light editorial sharpening of what you already have.

full.label: Help with the full website content
full.body: Initial content setup for core pages. Larger copywriting scopes are discussed separately.

self.label: I will arrange hosting myself
self.body: You provide the environment or DNS access.

cpwd.label: Hosting via CPWD
cpwd.body: Optional yearly plan, separate from the one-off project price.

summary.label: Project estimate // CPWD
summary.intakeNote: For custom functionality the final price may differ from this estimate after discussion.
summary.nonBindingBody: This is a first estimate based on your choices. After a short discussion you receive a final price, always before work starts.
summary.positioning: No heavy agency structure, just direct collaboration and a price that fits the project.
summary.disclaimer: The shown price is a non-binding indication, not a fixed quote. Complex custom work, external services, licenses and special technical requirements can affect the final price.
